subtopics.title: The Bank Reconciliation, Read for Meaning

questions.question: The bank statement shows R14 300 favourable, with an outstanding deposit of R9 800 and outstanding payments of R6 500. The ledger's bank balance is:
options: R17 600 — statement plus the unseen deposit less the unfelt payments

questions.question: A deposit still outstanding weeks after being recorded most commonly signals:
options: Rolling of cash — money received and recorded but never banked, the hole covered with later receipts

questions.question: Bank charges appearing only on the bank statement are treated by:
options: Adding them to the reconciliation statement
Recording them in the books first — the reconciliation carries only genuine timing differences
Subtracting them from the outstanding deposit

questions.question: The person who banks the cash should not prepare the bank reconciliation because:
options: Banking and arithmetic are different skills
Reconciliations must be done by managers only
The reconciliation is precisely where cash-handling fraud becomes visible — the thief must not control the lie detector

questions.question: An invoice of R6 200 for goods actually delivered appears on the supplier's statement but not in the ledger. The correction is:
options: Add R6 200 to the ledger side — the goods are real and the ledger must catch up

questions.question: A payment of R8 400 made on the twenty-eighth, missing from a statement drawn on the twenty-fifth, is:
options: A timing difference — subtract it from the statement side

questions.question: The R2 750 invoice belonging to a different customer is handled by:
options: Paying it to preserve the relationship
Subtracting it from the statement side — it is the supplier's posting error, and paying unreconciled statements is how you buy someone else's goods
Halving it with the other customer

questions.question: After all corrections both sides stand at R35 300, which is:
options: The average of the two starting balances
The true debt — the corrected ledger figure that belongs in trade payables and is the amount to pay

subtopics.title: Control Accounts and the Debtors' Age Analysis

questions.question: The debtors' control shows R120 000 but the debtors' list totals R118 700 because an invoice of R1 300 was never posted to a customer's personal account. The correction is:
options: Enter the invoice in the customer's account so the list also totals R120 000
Reduce the control account to R118 700
Write off R1 300 as bad debts

questions.question: In general, errors in journal totals affect the control account, while errors in posting to individual accounts affect:
On Zenzele's age analysis, current is 45 percent, thirty days 25 percent, sixty days 18 percent and ninety-plus days 12 percent. On 30-day terms, the overdue portion is:
options: 30 percent — the sixty-day and ninety-plus columns

questions.question: The ninety-day-and-older column deserves special attention because:
options: It always contains the largest amounts
Interest may never be charged on it
It is paid first by most debtors
Old debt is sick debt — it is where bad debts are born and where the provision for bad debts should be looking

subtopics.title: Ethics, Fraud and the Paper Trail

questions.question: Three-way matching before payment compares:
options: The order, the delivery note and the invoice
The budget, the forecast and the actual
The bank statement, the ledger and the trial balance
Last month, this month and next month

questions.question: A clerk writing off a friend's healthy debt is countered by:
options: Write-offs authorised independently of the ledger clerk, and management review of the age analysis

questions.question: Month-end window-dressing that reverses immediately after reporting day is detected by:
options: The reconciliation's memory — the same items recurring month after month form a visible pattern

questions.question: Paying suppliers on the last day within terms — not before, never after — is described as:
options: Treasury discipline — late payment costs interest, discounts and credit rating; early payment donates free financing

subtopics.title: Why Your Phone and Your Notebook Disagree

questions.question: Your notebook says R17 600 and the app says R14 300 after you banked R9 800 and sent payments of R6 500 tonight. The truth is:
options: Both are right — the records are keeping time differently, and the bridge proves it
The bank has lost your deposit
The notebook is wrong by R3 300
You have been robbed of R3 300

questions.question: A deposit sitting on the bridge for one weekend versus three weeks is the difference between:
options: Timing and trouble — three weeks means the money never reached the bank

questions.question: Rolling the cash stays invisible in daily records because:
options: Each day's hole is covered with the next day's takings — only the reconciliation shows deposits always one beat late
The notebook is never added up

questions.question: Bank charges the notebook has not heard about yet are:
options: Ridden across the bridge as timing differences
Recorded in the notebook first — only true timing differences ride the bridge

subtopics.title: The Supplier's Statement Says You Owe More

questions.question: Makoya's statement says R48 700 and your book says R29 100. The correct first move is:
options: Go difference by difference, assigning each one to the record that is behind or wrong
Pay the statement to avoid conflict
Pay your own figure and ignore the statement
Split the difference and pay R38 900

questions.question: After all corrections, the amount actually paid is:
options: R35 300 — the reconciled figure both records agree on

questions.question: Paying the raw statement would have cost an extra:
options: R13 400 — including R2 750 of someone else's shopping

questions.question: Fake invoices flow toward businesses that:
options: Pay statements unchecked — because someone has discovered they never look

subtopics.title: The List of Who Owes You, and For How Long

questions.question: Of the R12 000 owed to the airtime business, the sick portion is:
options: The R2 160 plus R1 440 that is beyond the one-month terms — the older the debt, the less likely it pays
The R3 000 that is one month old

questions.question: The escalation for overdue debtors runs in the order:
options: Reminder, then interest if the terms allow, then suspension of credit, then collection if worth the cost

questions.question: The real cure for bad debts happens before the debt is born, through:
options: A larger provision for bad debts
Credit checks, enforced limits and immediate invoicing

questions.question: The mirror image idea — that you are a line in a supplier's age analysis — means:
options: Your debtors see your bank balance
Paying late reclassifies you in their system: interest, tighter limits, cash up front — your credit rating pricing everything you buy
